feature_schema.source: Actual successful CSR read endpoints, runtime classified retired instructions and owned memory/cache events.

internal_validation_scope: Development set with earlier residual diagnostics viewed; not blind acceptance.

source_fit_scope.costs: Positive runtime-event costs only; no region intercept, negative adjustment, benchmark/PC lookup or trial feature.

outer.launch_scope: train-only saturated two-compute private-read1MiB; traffic history and physical miss counts remain unqualified
outer.single_hart_service_basis: train-only Rocket shared-DRAM outer-miss coefficient; common service transfer to compute is an explicit approximation, not a separately identified NoC path

source_fit_scope.quantization: Async extra setup/work projected onto nonnegative integer cycle coefficients over actual training work domains; data/path services retain native per-family fractional carry. Icache/branch services integer-rounded before native ceil.
unqualified: ScalarFP pipeline is structurally overconservative; no negative correction.
DRAM hot-load read-base forced0 because it is not charged by the actual L1-hit front.
Dirty-writeback separate cost not identified in this selected basis; left0.
Icache outer service has no independent fitted ROI miss basis; common service transfer is explicit.
BF16 and FP8 vector-FADD have no training instruction coverage; no timing coefficient applied.
Heavy late417reference regions lack matched native coverage.
TCM/scratch2banks and source ingress/NoC contention are not fully modeled.
Atomic/synchronization timing and hardware vector transport hang are unqualified.

timing_scope: Experimental additional effective services fitted to the NEW priority-v2 FPGA ELF; actual matched kernel counter replay only. Internal validation is development evidence. Default full-model, arbitrary-shape, whole-Zephyr/end-to-end, and 2% guarantees are unavailable.
